tagline.en_US: DB Browser for SQLite is a high quality, visual, open source tool to create, design, and edit database files compatible with SQLite.

description.en_US: DB Browser for SQLite is a visual tool designed to create, design, and edit database files compatible with SQLite. It offers a graphical interface that simplifies managing database structures, tables, and records without relying solely on command-line utilities. Users can inspect data, alter schemas, and handle database contents directly.
